target_transition: exact complex analytic rank two for the same E/Q -> a root-faithful arithmetic nonvanishing/localization witness without assuming algebraic rank two, Selmer rank two, p-adic BSD, an Iwasawa main conjecture of comparable strength, or regulator/height nondegeneracy of root strength

sources.title: Non-vanishing of Kolyvagin systems and Iwasawa theory
sources.verified_claim: For good ordinary p, Heegner Kolyvagin-system nonvanishing is proved under a rational anticyclotomic Iwasawa Main Conjecture; the cyclotomic Beilinson-Kato Kolyvagin-system analogue is likewise proved under a rational cyclotomic Main Conjecture. The paper also tracks Tamagawa divisibility in refined statements.
sources.reason: The desired arithmetic nonvanishing is obtained only after importing a main-conjecture premise; this does not source that premise from exact complex analytic rank two.

sources.title: A higher Gross-Zagier formula and the structure of Selmer groups
sources.author: Chan-Ho Kim
sources.verified_claim: The work treats Selmer structure without a low analytic-rank hypothesis and relates non-triviality of Kolyvagin systems to corresponding main conjectures localized at the augmentation ideal; arbitrary-rank applications are consequences of those main-conjecture inputs.
sources.reason: The arbitrary-rank Selmer route still enters through a localized main-conjecture/nontriviality condition rather than deriving the needed arithmetic witness directly from complex order two.

sources.title: On the structure of the Bloch--Kato Selmer groups of modular forms over anticyclotomic Z_p-towers
sources.verified_claim: Under generalized Heegner hypotheses, primitivity of the p-localization of the generalized Heegner cycle plus local conditions implies freeness of the anticyclotomic Selmer dual and vanishing of the Bloch--Kato--Shafarevich--Tate groups.
sources.reason: Primitivity/nonvanishing of the p-localization is a hypothesis, so the theorem is downstream of the R7 residual rather than a source for it.

sources.title: On the non-vanishing of generalized Kato classes for elliptic curves of rank 2
sources.verified_claim: Generalized-Kato nonvanishing implies two-dimensional p-adic Selmer, with a leading-term formula involving a derived p-adic height and enhanced p-adic regulator.
sources.reason: This source supplies the previously audited successor theorem cell but does not reverse the arithmetic conclusion from exact complex analytic rank two in arbitrary root scope.

negative_history_update: The Euler/Kolyvagin-system lane and the higher-Gross-Zagier/Selmer-structure lane both return to an arithmetic nonvanishing/main-conjecture/localization premise. This links R8 to the R7 transverse-localization failure without claiming an impossibility theorem.
